gr_list.description: Follow-up Rescue Alerts — identify rescue candidates from no_response/offered/offer_lost outcomes

plan.summary: RI-3.6 Follow-up Rescue Alerts engine. Identifies conversations with no_response/offered/offer_lost outcomes that are within 30-day window for follow-up rescue. Computes rescue_priority_score = recency(50%) + outcome_weight(50%). Same POST compute + GET read pattern as RI-3.1/3.3.
plan.q_intent: RI-3.6 Follow-up Rescue Alerts (Paket 3). Rescue = no_response + offered + offer_lost outcomes icin follow-up onerisi. Oncelik: ghost_rate yuksek + conversion potansiyeli olan konusmalar.
plan.interview_notes: Outcomes: no_response + offered + offer_lost (3 outcome). Score: recency(50%) + outcome_weight(50%) — basit, agent bilgisi yok. Cutoff: 30 gun. estimated_value: NULL (RI-4+'da eklenecek).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /api/ops/insights/compute/rescue computes rescue candidates from PG outcomes + MSSQL last message data, upserts to wa_rescue_candidates
GET /api/ops/insights/rescue/{tenantId} returns rescue candidates ordered by rescue_priority_score DESC
Only no_response, offered, offer_lost outcomes are considered as rescue candidates
rescue_priority_score formula: recency(50%) + outcome_weight(50%), where recency 0d=100/30d=0 linear, outcome_weight offered=100/offer_lost=70/no_response=40
Conversations older than 30 days are excluded from rescue candidates

files_changed.change: RI-3.6 rescue compute service: MSSQL last message CTE, 30-day cutoff, priority scoring, dedup, PG upsert

verification_questions.question: Does the rescue service only consider no_response, offered, and offer_lost outcome labels?
Are conversations older than 30 days correctly excluded from rescue candidate computation?
Does the MSSQL query follow the established cross-DB read pattern (parameterized IN, NOLOCK, batch)?
Are rescue candidates deduplicated by conversation_id before PG upsert (multi-instance protection)?

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: MSSQL batch errors are logged+counted, total error count returned in result. PG upsert failures propagate.
